candidates.title: Google ships ADK for Kotlin 1.0
candidates.summary: The production release brings agent orchestration to Kotlin and Android with on-device models, Firebase AI, state persistence, context compaction, and type-safe tools.
candidates.what_changed: Google's Agent Development Kit for Kotlin reached 1.0 with parity across the core ADK surface and additional Android-first features.
candidates.why_it_matters: Agent frameworks are moving beyond Python-first prototypes. Kotlin support makes agent patterns more credible for Android, JVM services, and mixed local/cloud workflows.

sources.label: Google Developers Blog — Announcing ADK for Kotlin 1.0

candidates.title: Dario Amodei calls for slowing frontier capability growth
candidates.summary: Anthropic's CEO argued that frontier labs should coordinate on safety and slow capability advancement enough for oversight and safeguards to catch up.
candidates.what_changed: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei argued that frontier AI companies should deliberately slow capability advancement enough to improve evaluation, coordination, and safety controls.
candidates.why_it_matters: For engineers, this debate eventually becomes concrete requirements around release gates, model evaluations, incident reporting, and deployment controls. Governance is increasingly moving closer to the development lifecycle.

candidates.title: Anthropic maps how malicious actors are operationalizing AI
candidates.summary: Anthropic's September threat report shows Claude being used across cyber operations, surveillance, fraud, weapons software, and illicit distillation workflows.
candidates.what_changed: Anthropic's September 2026 threat-intelligence report is useful because it focuses on **operating patterns**, not hypothetical misuse.
candidates.why_it_matters: Security teams should assume that sophisticated attack workflows are becoming easier to automate. Defensive controls need to focus on **capability boundaries, credential scope, network access, observability, and abuse detection**, not only model refusals.

sources.label: Anthropic — Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026

candidates.title: EVOHARNESSBENCH shows agents can forget when their harness improves
candidates.summary: The benchmark changes tools, skills, and subagents over time and finds that harness expansion can degrade previously solved tasks.
candidates.what_changed: EVOHARNESSBENCH evaluates agents while their external harness evolves: tools are added, skills change, and specialist agents appear over time.
candidates.why_it_matters: Agent platforms need regression testing for the **harness itself**. Adding a tool or subagent should be treated like changing a production API surface, not like harmless context enrichment.

sources.label: EVOHARNESSBENCH: Can Your Agents Keep Pace with an Evolving Harness?

candidates.title: Looped Flows lets models spend more inference compute on hard problems
candidates.summary: A new recurrent inference method trains local denoising objectives so additional loops at inference time can improve reasoning without long backpropagation through the full recurrence.
candidates.what_changed: Looped Flows explores a familiar idea from a different angle: let the model spend more computation on difficult inputs by repeatedly updating hidden state during inference.
candidates.why_it_matters: This is another sign that **inference-time compute is becoming an architectural knob**, not merely a decoding trick. The result is still a preprint and needs broader replication.

candidates.title: Magenta closes the loop between informal math and Lean verification
candidates.summary: A training-free pipeline converts natural-language solutions into Lean statements, checks formalization fidelity, and routes failures back to math reasoning or proof repair.
candidates.what_changed: Magenta connects informal mathematical reasoning to machine-checkable Lean proofs without requiring a separately trained theorem-proving model.
candidates.why_it_matters: The architecture is the interesting part: **verification is not the final step; it actively steers the reasoning loop**. That pattern generalizes well beyond mathematics.

sources.label: Magenta: Closing the Loop Between Mathematical Reasoning and Lean Verification
